260:t_013:8.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「...We seem to be closer to the galactic center than before.」

260:t_013:11.en:
$$葵$$
「No way...! That doesn't just get us nowhere, it puts us farther behind!」

260:t_013:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return. We'll assess the situation.」

260:t_013:15.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Good grief... One step forward, two steps back... Things certainly aren't going smoothly...」

260:t_014:0.en:
$$渓$$
「We've got a good rhythm! Let's keep charging ahead!」

260:t_014:1.en:
$$號$$
「Understood. We'll combine everyone's strength and keep this chain of attacks going.」

260:t_015:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(So these are a parallel world's $$宇宙怪獣$$... They certainly are formidable...)

260:t_015:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(But I must get their data to $$タイタン$$, no matter what...)

260:t_015:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(No... I may already be out of time... If necessary, I'll do it alone...)

260:t_016:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「T-to fall now, with the universe in danger... I've been careless...!」

260:t_100:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
(This is $$ノノ$$'s first time fighting them, yet they somehow feel familiar... $$ノノ$$... doesn't understand herself...)

260:t_101:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ are still $$宇宙怪獣$$, even in a parallel world!」

260:t_101:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go, $$ディスヌフ$$! Destroying $$宇宙怪獣$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$'s mission!」

260:t_102:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「Could these things... be stronger than the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we used to fight...!?」

260:t_102:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Ugh! I don't know why, but these things... are hard to fight!」

260:t_103:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(I've finally found you, parallel-world $$宇宙怪獣$$... Though I never imagined it would happen this way.)

260:t_103:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(That fulfills one of my objectives. Now I just have to work out how to take this data back.)

260:t_104:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$... I thought the survivors had been transported here along with me, but...」

260:t_104:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「If they exist in this world, too, $$ガンバスター$$ and I will take them on...!」

260:t_104:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Humanity won't perish...! We will protect it, no matter what!」

260:t_104:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's the promise I made to Coach and Big Sis!!」

260:t_105:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「So the surviving $$ミケーネ$$ gods fled to the galactic center!」

260:t_105:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I won't go out of my way to chase you, but if you come to us, I'll take you on!」

260:t_105:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Come and get me! If that's what you want, I'll send you to see $$ハーデス$$!」

260:t_106:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(I can feel it...! A crisis is approaching this universe...!)

260:t_106:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(The universe's collapse, once every 12,000 years...! No, that's not it...! An even greater crisis will soon arrive!)
